zh.name: 大闹天宫·擎天
zh.description: 孙悟空在距离最远的<color=#02ff00>2</color>名敌人身后各召唤一个分身，继承本体<color=#02ff00>80%</color>的属性，持续<color=#02ff00>10</color>秒，然后本体和分身同时蓄力金箍棒对最近目标及周围单位造成<color=#02ff00>600%</color>攻击力的伤害，并击倒敌人（场上最多存在<color=#02ff00>10</color>个分身）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：蓄力金箍棒对最近目标及周围单位造成<color=#02ff00>650%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Charged Golden Cudgel deals 650% ATK as DMG to the nearest target and surrounding units.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：分身继承本体属性提升至<color=#02ff00>100%</color>
等级4：蓄力金箍棒对最近目标及周围单位造成<color=#02ff00>700%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Charged Golden Cudgel deals 700% ATK as DMG to the nearest target and surrounding units.

en.name: Havoc in Heaven: Pillar of the Sky
en.description: Sun Wukong summons a clone behind each of the 2 farthest enemies. Clones inherit 80% of his attributes and last 10s. Then Sun Wukong and his clones charge the Golden Cudgel at the same time, dealing 600% ATK as DMG to the nearest target and surrounding units and knocking enemies down (up to 10 clones can exist on the field).

zh.name: 腾云突击
zh.description: 在自身周围召唤一个分身，继承本体<color=#02ff00>60%</color>的属性，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒，随后孙悟空和该分身突进至敌方攻击力最高的敌人身边，对其造成<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的伤害，并对目标附加"破绽"（破绽：目标受到孙悟空及分身的伤害提升<color=#02ff00>20%</color>）命中目标后孙悟空获得自身<color=#02ff00>20%</color>最大生命值的护盾，持续<color=#02ff00>6</color>秒

upgrades.zh: 等级2：分身继承本体属性提升至<color=#02ff00>80%</color>
upgrades.en: The clone inherits 80% of his attributes.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力
等级4：破绽：目标受到孙悟空及分身的伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>30%</color>
upgrades.en: Opening: the target takes 30% more damage from Sun Wukong and his clones.

en.name: Cloud-Riding Strike
en.description: Summons a clone around himself that inherits 60% of his attributes and lasts 8s. Then Sun Wukong and the clone dash to the enemy with the highest ATK, dealing 200% ATK as DMG and applying "Opening" to the target (Opening: the target takes 20% more damage from Sun Wukong and his clones). After hitting the target, Sun Wukong gains a shield equal to 20% of his Max HP for 6s.

zh.name: 金刚不坏
zh.description: 被动的，场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，孙悟空提升<color=#02ff00>25%</color>攻击力，受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>5%</color>，分身消失时，本体获得<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的护盾

upgrades.zh: 等级2：场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，孙悟空提升<color=#02ff00>30%</color>攻击力
upgrades.en: For each clone on the field, Sun Wukong gains 30% ATK.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>10%</color>
upgrades.en: For each clone on the field, damage taken is reduced by 10%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：分身消失时，为孙悟空提供<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力的的护盾
upgrades.en: When a clone disappears, Sun Wukong gains a shield equal to 300% ATK.

en.name: Diamond Body
en.description: Passive: for each clone on the field, Sun Wukong gains 25% ATK and takes 5% less damage. When a clone disappears, Sun Wukong gains a shield equal to 200% ATK.

zh.name: 当头一棒
zh.description: 孙悟空与所有分身同时释放"当头一棒"，对最近敌人造成<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的伤害，并眩晕目标2秒，本次伤害额外造成目标<color=#02ff00>5%</color>最大生命值的伤害，场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，额外叠加<color=#02ff00>1</color>次，额外伤害最高不超过（<color=#02ff00>1</color>+分身数量）*<color=#02ff00>400%</color>攻击力的伤害

upgrades.zh: 等级2：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力
等级3：额外造成目标<color=#02ff00>7%</color>最大生命值的伤害,场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，额外叠加<color=#02ff00>1</color>次（额外伤害最高不超过<color=#02ff00>1</color>+分身数量*<color=#02ff00>500%</color>攻击力的伤害）
upgrades.en: Bonus damage increased to 7% of the target's Max HP, applied one additional time for each clone on the field (bonus damage capped at (1 + number of clones) x 500% ATK).

upgrades.zh: 等级4：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力

en.name: Blow to the Head
en.description: Sun Wukong and all clones cast "Blow to the Head" at the same time, dealing 200% ATK as DMG to the nearest enemy and stunning the target for 2s. This hit also deals bonus damage equal to 5% of the target's Max HP, and for each clone on the field this bonus is applied one additional time. Bonus damage is capped at (1 + number of clones) x 400% ATK.

levels.zh: 释放终结技时，额外召唤<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，同时每损失<color=#02ff00>50%</color>最大生命值，在孙悟空周围额外召唤<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身
levels.en: When casting his ultimate, summons 1 additional clone. In addition, for every 50% of Max HP lost, summons 1 additional clone around Sun Wukong.

levels.zh: 孙悟空本体和分身每释放<color=#02ff00>1</color>次【当头一棒】，使该技能的冷却降低<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒（每次最多可降低<color=#02ff00>10</color>秒）
levels.en: Each time Sun Wukong or a clone casts [Blow to the Head], that skill's cooldown is reduced by 2s (up to 10s per cast).

levels.zh: 场上每存在<color=#02ff00>1</color>个分身，本体与分身均增加<color=#02ff00>20%</color>攻击速度
levels.en: For each clone on the field, Sun Wukong and his clones gain 20% ATK Speed.

levels.zh: 场上有分身存在时，孙悟空即将阵亡时将位移至当前生命值最高的分身身上，恢复<color=#02ff00>100%</color>的生命值，分身代替死亡，一场战斗只能触发一次
levels.en: While a clone exists, when Sun Wukong is about to fall he moves to the clone with the highest current HP and restores 100% of his HP; the clone dies in his place. Can trigger only once per battle.

en.name: Ruyi Golden Cudgel
en.skillName: Lingering Might of the Great Sage
